ordenes-generales:
D=/home/learner/aso/f12
date +%d/%m/%Y > $D/fecha.txt
id learner > $D/identidad.txt
echo 'Practicando ASO' > $D/mensaje.txt
ficheros-basicos:
P=/home/learner/aso/f12/proyecto
mkdir -p $P/{conf,docs,tmp}
cp /etc/hosts /etc/shells /etc/os-release $P/conf
mv $P/conf/os-release $P/conf/sistema.txt
touch $P/docs/LEEME
cp -r /etc/skel $P/skel
rmdir $P/tmp
rm $P/skel/.bash_logout
ayuda:
D=/home/learner/aso/f12
which passwd chage crontab > $D/which.txt
whereis -b ls passwd > $D/whereis.txt
man -f crontab > $D/secciones.txt
echo 5 > $D/seccion5.txt
llaves-comillas:
D=/home/learner/aso/f12
mkdir -p $D/curso/tema{1..3}/{teoria,practica}
mkdir -p $D/logs && touch $D/logs/log-{01..12}.txt
echo 'El precio es $5 y mi casa es $HOME' > $D/comillas.txt
HOME=/home/learner
echo "Mi casa es $HOME" >> $D/comillas.txt
visores-editores:
D=/home/learner/aso/f12
awk '$1=="ssh" && $2 ~ /\/tcp$/ {split($2,a,"/"); print a[1]; exit}' /etc/services > $D/puerto-ssh.txt
{ cat /etc/hosts; echo '127.0.0.1 aso.local'; } > $D/hosts.txt
awk '$1=="PASS_MAX_DAYS" {print $2}' /etc/login.defs > $D/pass-max.txt
redirecciones:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
ls -l /etc/passwd /etc/no-existe > salida.txt 2> errores.txt || true
ls -l /etc/passwd /etc/no-existe > todo.txt 2>&1 || true
head -3 /etc/passwd > acumulado.txt
tail -2 /etc/group >> acumulado.txt
sort < /etc/shells > ordenado.txt
head -c 4096 < /dev/zero > ceros.bin
find /etc -name '*.repo' 2>/dev/null > repos.txt
filtros-basicos:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
head -5 /etc/passwd > primeras.txt
tail -3 /etc/group > ultimas.txt
nl /etc/shells > numeradas.txt
wc -l < /etc/services > lineas-services.txt
head -10 /etc/passwd | tail -1 > linea10.txt
cut-sort-uniq:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd | sort > logins.txt
cut -d: -f7 /etc/passwd | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr > shells.txt
sort -t: -k3,3n /etc/passwd | tail -3 | cut -d: -f1 > uid-altos.txt
cut -d: -f4 /etc/passwd | sort -n | uniq -d > gid-repetidos.txt
tr:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' < /etc/shells > mayusculas.txt
head -1 /etc/passwd | tr ':' '\n' > campos-root.txt
head -5 /etc/group | tr -d '0-9' > sin-digitos.txt
tuberias:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
ls -d /etc/*.conf | wc -l > num-conf.txt
grep -c 'nologin$' /etc/passwd > nologin.txt
ls -S /usr/bin | head -5 > grandes.txt
grep -c '/tcp' /etc/services > tcp.txt
grep ':/bin/bash$' /etc/passwd | cut -d: -f1 | sort > bash-users.txt
grep-regex:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
grep -c '^q[^u]' /usr/share/dict/words > q-sin-u.txt
grep -E '^[aeiou]{4,}$' /usr/share/dict/words > vocales.txt
grep '^z...a$' /usr/share/dict/words > z5a.txt
grep -E '[[:space:]]80/tcp' /etc/services > puerto80.txt
grep -Ev '^#|^$' /etc/login.defs > login-defs.txt
grep -w learner /etc/group > learner-grupo.txt
sed:
cd /home/learner/aso/f12
head -5 /etc/passwd | sed 's/:/ | /g' > passwd-barras.txt
sed '/^[[:space:]]*#/d' /etc/bashrc > bashrc-limpio.txt
sed 's|.*/||' /etc/shells > nombres-shell.txt
sed -n '3,6p' /etc/group > group-3-6.txt
